scope: Agent Core Capabilities - LLM Integration, Reasoning Loop, Sub-Agent Runtime
activeNote: Tasks 111-130 cover the critical Agent core capabilities: LLM provider abstraction, reasoning loop, intent parsing, task decomposition, streaming response handling, and Sub-Agent runtime. These are P0/P1 priority tasks that enable the Agent to actually work.

tasks.title: LLM提供商抽象层实现
tasks.description: Implement a unified LLM provider abstraction layer that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.) with failover and token tracking.
steps: Define LLMProvider interface with unified completion and streaming methods
Implement OpenAI-compatible provider as the baseline
Create ModelRouter for provider selection and failover

tasks.title: LLM提供商配置UI集成
tasks.description: Integrate LLM provider configuration with the existing settings UI, supporting API key management, model selection, and connection testing.
steps: Extend LLMProviderDefaults component with real provider integration
Implement API key secure storage with encryption
Add model selection dropdown with available models per provider

tasks.title: Agent推理循环核心实现
tasks.description: Implement the core Agent reasoning loop that processes user input, generates plans, selects tools, executes them, and produces responses.
steps: Create AgentLoop class with iterative reasoning cycle
Implement context assembly from memory, tools, and department context
Create response parser for tool call extraction
Implement iteration limit and timeout handling

tasks.title: 意图解析引擎实现
tasks.description: Implement intent parsing engine that classifies user intent, extracts entities, resolves context references, and handles multimodal input.
steps: Create IntentClassifier for intent type classification
Implement MultimodalParser for image/PDF content extraction
Add clarification mechanism for ambiguous requests

tasks.title: 任务分解器实现
tasks.description: Implement task decomposition that breaks complex requests into executable steps with dependencies and priorities.
steps: Add priority assignment based on task complexity

tasks.title: 流式响应处理实现
tasks.description: Implement streaming response handling with real-time content rendering, thinking process extraction, and tool call parsing.
steps: Create StreamParser for SSE response parsing
Create ContentRenderer for real-time markdown rendering
Add ToolCallParser for streaming tool call detection

tasks.title: 工具选择智能实现
tasks.description: Implement intelligent tool selection based on semantic similarity, tool descriptions, and context matching.
steps: Implement tool description embedding and indexing
Implement fallback handler for tool failures

tasks.title: Agent观察面板实现
tasks.description: Implement Agent observability panel showing thinking process, tool call chains, decision explanations, and performance metrics.
steps: Create ThinkingVisualizer component for thought display
Implement ToolChainViewer for call chain visualization

tasks.title: Sub-Agent运行时核心实现
tasks.description: Implement the core Sub-Agent runtime that enables creation, execution, and management of user-owned Sub-Agents with isolated contexts.

tasks.title: Sub-Agent协调器实现
tasks.description: Implement Sub-Agent orchestrator for parallel execution, dependency resolution, and conflict handling.
steps: Create ParallelExecutor for concurrent Sub-Agent execution

tasks.title: Sub-Agent配置集成
tasks.description: Integrate Sub-Agent runtime with existing configuration UI, enabling persona, tool binding, permission, and model configuration.

tasks.title: Sub-Agent执行监控集成
tasks.description: Integrate Sub-Agent execution monitoring with UI, showing real-time status, call chains, and execution history.

tasks.title: Prompt模板引擎实现
tasks.description: Implement prompt template engine with variable resolution, context injection, and version management.

tasks.title: 记忆层自动集成实现
tasks.description: Implement automatic memory integration with session lifecycle hooks for memory extraction, retrieval, and update.
steps: Implement automatic memory extraction on session end
Add memory retrieval injection to prompt context

tasks.title: 部门Pilot运行时集成
tasks.description: Implement actual department Pilot runtime integration that provides context, tools, and knowledge for specific departments.
steps: Implement FinancePilot runtime with actual tool bindings
Implement SalesPilot runtime with actual tool bindings
Implement ApprovalPilot runtime with actual tool bindings
Create PilotRegistry for department pilot management
Integrate pilots with Agent reasoning loop

tasks.title: 跨部门协作编排实现
tasks.description: Implement cross-department collaboration orchestration that enables Agent to work across department boundaries.
steps: Add public tool discovery across departments
Implement result aggregation from multiple departments

tasks.title: Agent调试与诊断工具
tasks.description: Implement Agent debugging and diagnostic tools including trace recording, replay, prompt inspection, and error diagnosis.
steps: Create TraceRecorder for execution trace capture

tasks.title: MCP工具运行时集成
tasks.description: Implement actual MCP tool runtime integration with tool discovery, execution, and approval flow.
steps: Connect MCPServiceConnection to actual MCP servers
Implement MCPToolDiscovery with real tool enumeration

tasks.title: Skill运行时集成
tasks.description: Implement actual Skill runtime integration with skill loading, execution, and progressive enhancement.
steps: Create SkillLoader for skill module loading

tasks.title: Agent端到端集成测试
tasks.description: Implement end-to-end integration tests for the complete Agent flow from user input to response generation.
steps: Create E2E test scenarios for common use cases
Implement mock LLM provider for testing
